subject.title: Feature Request: First-class Projects in Gateway Dashboard (workspace + skill scoping + runtime constraints)

question: What first-class Project MVP should OpenClaw own in core, and should project-scoped tools/skills/runtime constraints be warn-only metadata or enforced policy?
rationale: The current code has several reusable primitives, but storage ownership, Gateway protocol shape, UI hierarchy, upgrade path, and security semantics require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Core Projects MVP
options.body: Add a narrow core Project store, additive projects.* Gateway methods, Projects UI, project-to-home-session/workspace bindings, and warn-only constraint display first.

options.title: Session Grouping Only
options.body: Limit the first iteration to project-like labels or tree grouping over existing sessions and agents, deferring Project storage and enforcement.

options.title: Defer To Plugins
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a concrete plugin/API gap is identified, accepting that the dashboard will not have first-class Projects for now.

recommendation.title: Core Projects MVP
recommendation.body: Add a narrow core Project store, additive projects.* Gateway methods, Projects UI, project-to-home-session/workspace bindings, and warn-only constraint display first.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing owner from CONTRIBUTING.md, current-main provenance, and the prior canonical keep-open comments.
